Vaishnavi Kalyan Kulkarni’s learning journey at 3RI Technologies explores this connection. Through her Data Analytics course in Pune, she gained experience with Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, and Tableau while working on projects that brought the concepts into practice. This preparation supported her move into the role of MIS Executive at GreenJoules. Table of Contents Shrutika Patil September 16, 2026 6:00 pm Introduction Vaishnavi Kalyan Kulkarni’s practical Data analytics training journey can help you build skills relevant to the workplace. She enrolled in the Data Analytics Course at 3RI Technologies to develop a stronger understanding of data handling, reporting, visualization, and analytics tools. She worked on making the connection between technical principles and business-oriented requirements through project-based learning, practical activities, and scheduled teaching. After completing her training, Vaishnavi moved into a professional role as an MIS Executive at GreenJoules , applying her learning in a corporate environment. The Challenge Vaishnavi needed more than theoretical knowledge to prepare for an analytics-related career. She needed to understand how data is collected, cleaned, analyzed, organized, and presented for business reporting. Developing familiarity with multiple tools and understanding when to use them was also an important part of her learning journey. Her training requirements included: What Vaishnavi Needed to Learn How 3RI Technologies Supported Her Learning Handling data confidently Practiced Excel, formulas, data cleaning, and working with structured datasets through hands-on exercises. Understanding data effectively Worked with SQL, Python, Pandas, and NumPy to explore, organize, and analyze data. Turning data into useful reports Learned Power BI, DAX, dashboards, and visualization techniques to present information clearly. Building practical experience Applied classroom concepts to business scenarios and project-based activities instead of relying only on theory. Preparing for the workplace Took part in mock interviews, resume guidance, project discussions, and career-focused activities. The key requirement was to bring these areas together so that technical learning could be connected with practical reporting and business requirements. The Learning Approach at 3RI Technologies 3RI Technologies provides a 5-month Data Analytics Course in Pune with an emphasis on practical learning and project-based activities. Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and Generative AI are all covered in the program, along with ideas related to data cleaning, analysis, visualization, and reporting. Vaishnavi’s training involved learning individual tools while also understanding how they contribute to an analytics workflow. Practical exercises helped her work with datasets, identify useful information, prepare reports, and present findings through visualizations. The course also includes 2 real-time projects , giving learners an opportunity to apply classroom concepts to practical scenarios. Interview preparation, resume guidance, portfolio development, and mock interviews further connect technical training with career preparation. The Learning Path of Data Analytics Training in Pune Vaishnavi’s learning path progressed from fundamental concepts toward practical analytics applications. The training linked many technologies with common data-related activities rather than addressing each technology as a distinct subject. Excel & Data Fundamentals: She developed familiarity with spreadsheets, formulas, data cleaning, Pivot Tables, charts, and basic reporting. SQL Practice: She worked with queries, filtering, grouping, joins, and data extraction using structured datasets. Python for Analytics: Python, Pandas, and NumPy were introduced for data manipulation, cleaning, exploration, and analysis during the training. Power BI & Tableau: She learned how dashboards and visual reports can be used to communicate information more clearly, including exposure to DAX . Project-Based Practice: Practical business scenarios provided opportunities to work through stages such as preparing data, analyzing information, creating reports, and presenting insights. Industry-Oriented Exposure: Case studies and Generative AI concepts added perspective on evolving analytics practices and workplace requirements. Career Preparation: Mock interviews, resume guidance, portfolio development, and project discussions helped connect technical learning with professional expectations. This progression provided a practical path from learning concepts to using analytics tools for reporting and business-focused tasks. The Outcome of Data Analytics Courses in Pune The training gave Vaishnavi an opportunity to strengthen her understanding of analytics tools and apply those concepts through practical activities. Her progress can be viewed through the skills and professional transition achieved during her learning journey. Technical Skill Development: She learned how to use Excel, SQL, Python, Pandas, NumPy, Power BI, Tableau, and DAX. Practical Learning: Project-based exercises allowed her to work with data preparation, analysis, reporting, and visualization tasks. Business Reporting Understanding: Working with dashboards and structured datasets helped connect technical activities with reporting requirements. Improved Project Readiness: Practical work provided experience that could be discussed during professional interactions and interviews. Career Transition: After completing her training, Vaishnavi Kalyan Kulkarni joined GreenJoules as an MIS Executive , taking her analytics learning into a professional work environment. Her outcome illustrates how structured training combined with practical exposure can support a Vaishnavi move from classroom learning toward a workplace role. Data Analytics Training at 3RI Technologies At 3RI Technologies, Data Analytics Training in Pune focuses on building practical understanding rather than limiting learning to theoretical concepts. The training covers tools including Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and Generative AI, supported by hands-on exercises and project-based learning. Learners also receive exposure to real-time projects, business use cases, mock interviews, resume guidance, portfolio development, certification, and career support . These components help connect technical knowledge with the types of tasks learners may encounter while pursuing analytics-oriented opportunities. Vaishnavi Kalyan Kulkarni’s progression to an MIS Executive role at GreenJoules provides a concrete example of how a structured learning journey can help a learner build relevant technical skills and apply them in a professional setting.
